content.short: Collection of 10 000 procedurally generated NFTs from hand-drawn components.
content.description: Zombie Owls is a collection of 10 000 procedurally generated NFTs. Zombie Owl NFT consists of 13 components. Our software chooses each owl part procedurally, meaning while the components are random, some have a much lower chance of being selected. You can check the rarity of your Owl on the website or cnft tools. While there will ever be only 10 000 Zombie Owls, there are more than 42 million possible combinations of the hand-drawn components. Owls are generated at the mint time - it's always a surprise what you'll get!
